Definition: Serajah, the name of nine Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Seraiah is a name nine Israelites carried, and three of them stand in these verses. One is the son of Kenaz, brother of Othniel; one is Seraiah the chief priest, taken by the captain of the guard when Jerusalem fell; and one is Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name shows both ends of Judah's story: a chief priest carried away in judgment, and a captain coming to the governor God left behind.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
